authors: National Center for Health Statistics, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2011-2012: Physical Activity Monitor - Raw Data 80 Hz (PAX80_G). First published January 2022; revised October 2022.
notes: The authoritative release documentation, rather than a secondary HAR paper, defines the waveform used by HALO. It specifies 6,917 public participants aged 6+, ActiGraph GT3X+ triaxial acceleration at 80 Hz in g, preferably on the non-dominant wrist for seven consecutive days, up to 194 hourly CSV files per participant, and per-participant QC intervals. No activity diary was collected. HALO therefore uses a deterministic bounded subset only for label-free Phase A and excludes its reserved __unlabeled__ marker from semantic vocabulary, validation, and Phase B.
